items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Well, her name was Amanda, and they called her Mandy.

ctx.x: Before we get started, I'd like to add something. When we were here on Reel 1, we were talking about my grandmother, and for the life of me, I couldn't think of her name. Well, her name was Amanda, and they called her Mandy.
Do you know what her maiden name was?
